overview: The Royal District houses Shar Vahl’s palace complex, council chambers, and ceremonial plazas.
history: The district was built around the original royal court of Shar Vahl.
Clan envoys were granted formal access routes through the district.
Ceremonial grounds were expanded to host major city rites.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the district was reinforced and terraced.
Royal Guard and Shadow-Threat Watch established joint posts here.
hooks: A royal procession is disrupted by an unexpected hazard.
A clan envoy arrives with urgent news from the outer regions.
A council session spills into the plazas as tensions rise.
A Shadow-Threat report reaches the palace through the district.
